name: Flower of the North Star
source:
The greedy giantness Móra has been offered a large sum of gold for a flower from her garden. But as she travels to the fairy place...could she learn a thing or two about changing her ways before things are too late?

[From [url=https://cloudnovel.net/ZodiacStories/novel/flower-of-the-north-star]Cloudnovel[/url]]

Created for Cloudnovel's Jolly Jam 2018.
translation:
贪婪的巨人莫拉收到了一大笔黄金来换取她花园里的一朵花。但当她前往仙境时……她能在事情为时已晚之前学到一两件事来改变自己的生活方式吗？

[摘自[url=https://cloudnovel.net/ZodiacStories/novel/flower-of-the-north-star]Cloudnovel[/url]]
